gaps.sentence: ___ the strike, trains will run a reduced service all week.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of the strike' gives the reason for the reduced service.

gaps.sentence: He whispered ___ the children wouldn't hear.
gaps.explanation: 'So that + wouldn't' expresses intended (here negative) purpose.

gaps.sentence: The delegates arrived early ___ have time to network.
gaps.explanation: 'So as to + infinitive' = in order to, a formal purpose linker.

gaps.sentence: ___ a staffing shortage, the clinic closed early.
gaps.explanation: 'Due to + noun phrase' states the cause in formal register.
'Due to personal reasons' is the standard collocation for giving a cause.

gaps.sentence: He passed the oral exam ___ the fact that he had barely revised.
gaps.explanation: 'The fact that' turns the clause into a noun phrase, which 'despite' requires.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: The 'than' in the sentence forces 'No sooner', the only linker paired with than.

gaps.sentence: ___ it rains all weekend, the ceremony will still be held outdoors.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a possible (not yet real) condition.
